item.description: A team of Bengali astronomers led by Sabyasachi Pal has discovered 369 radio quasars, including 53 giant radio quasars stretching up to 7.2 million light-years, using GMRT data. The breakthrough sheds new light on the evolution of radio galaxies and cosmic environments.

item.description: Two youths from East Midnapore died in a tragic road accident at Mundumari crossing in Pingla when a speeding bike collided head-on with a bus. Police seized both vehicles and restored traffic after temporary disruption.
